resources.string: Pause, rewind or speed up time to one day per second with the revised time scale.
Location changes take effect when you return to the main sky; time stays paused while you configure them.
Future Location dates and times stay visible at the top of the sky, with their UTC offset.
Re-enabling time restores your last speed, including pause and reverse.
A new day clears selected points on live paths, while fixed dated comparisons remain selected.
More compact azimuth and elevation labels; photos and panoramas show time and T at opposite edges.
